visual_identity.full_fusion_brief_en:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: C-14 CUTBANK, original Star Warfare Perseus armor ID 13, user-requested closed-helmet correction.
Input images: Image 1 is the CURRENT new full-body concept and the EDIT TARGET. Its BODY, pose, proportions, material finish and framing must remain fixed. Images 2, 3 and 4 are actual original Perseus model views, supplied ONLY to restore its original CLOSED HELMET design language. No EOD helmet image is supplied. The previous glass eye-band direction is explicitly rejected by the user.
Primary request: Change ONLY the helmet from the base of the neck upward. Preserve the exact standing person, heavy layered shoulders, charcoal green-gray split chest armor, orange trim, black soft neck / elbow / knee / waist joints, arm plates and markings, trousers, thigh panels, shin shells, boots, hands, pose and neutral background from Image 1. Do not redesign the torso or recolor the suit.
New helmet: Return to the original Perseus's tall enclosed angular monolithic face shell. It is one continuous OPAQUE hard armored faceplate extending from the high rounded-faceted forehead down to a tapered closed lower face, with a strong long central vertical ridge and sloping broad side facets. A narrow rust-orange stripe crosses the very top of the crown toward the rear. Fine pale gray-white fork-like marks follow the long face facets and converge downward into a closed V near the lower center, informed by the original multi-view references; make them restrained painted or etched lines on opaque metal. Keep the shell physically thick at its lower edge and peripheral seams, with matte charcoal green metal, broad bevels and subtle wear matching the body. Improve the two low side breathing fittings into small recessed short filters seated BELOW the solid face shell. Retain human-sized helmet scale, padded neck seal and room for a person's head.
Critical user constraint: Absolutely NO goggles, NO goggle-shaped region, NO horizontal glass band, NO exposed eye window, NO transparent or smoked glass, NO visor lens, NO eye slits, NO separate robotic eyes and NO uncovered face. The forehead-to-chin face surface is armored metal of continuous shape; do not hide a black eye-band inside a seam. Do not create a beak, skull, smiling mouth, android face or pilot mask. The white fork markings must read as thin surface markings, not glowing eyes or transparent openings. Use the source helmet's elongated smooth central folded shell rather than EOD's protruding brow over a lens.
Construction limits: Only a few subtle edge fasteners and lower vents. No new large sensors, antennas, giant horns or weapons. Existing neck and collar remain wearable and articulated; this user-requested closed shell can coexist with the already approved human body design.
Composition / output: same full-body near-front three-quarter concept as Image 1, portrait 1024 x 1536, every helmet and sole in frame, no caption, logo or measurements. Keep all body pixels and design structure as closely as possible; make the closed head correction clear and deliberate. Do not put a backpack into this front concept. Subsequent turnaround will fit the separately designed B-14.

actual_reviews.concept: 已目視：原護目鏡水平玻璃帶已完全移除，改為高而封閉的整片不透明硬質面殼，中央長折面與向下收合白色分叉線清楚；窄橘冠條、下側短濾件保留。沒有露眼窗、眼縫或玻璃反光。現有身體的墨綠煤灰配色、胸板、層肩、前臂橘紋、腿甲、姿態與人體軟關節維持。實際頭部相對舊稿較高以承接原Perseus輪廓，後续建模需驗證轉頭與肩甲間隙。
actual_reviews.construction: 已目視：頭盔組裝與拆件都明確是整片不透明硬質面殼，中央縱折面、白色下收分叉線和橘冠條一致；拆下的面殼有實體厚度，沒有玻璃片、護目鏡、眼孔或眼縫。內部為可容納人頭的軟墊，兩側短濾件可拆；層肩和黑布肘膝符合現有身體。B-14 銀灰架、紅褐雙筒、中央階梯風口、背帶和背部示意維持独立配色。此為近似裝配參考，真實鎖點、面殼拆卸順序及頭肩活動間隙仍需建模驗證。
actual_reviews.turnaround: 已目視：正面、穿戴者左側和背面完整且近似同高；前與側頭盔都為高封閉硬面殼、下收白分叉線與橘冠條，沒有護目鏡、透明面窗或眼縫，背面沒有多畫一張臉。原身體層肩、胸甲、橘前臂紋及軟關節維持。B-14 的銀灰框、紅褐雙筒與中央梯形風口保留獨立配色。側視背包／高肩／後腦間距較緊，建模時仍需轉頭與抬臂檢查，三視不是精確尺寸。

proposed_stats.basis: 本輪未指定新HP／盾；現有 runtime 不變，不由外觀、Halo 或舊來源技能文字推算。

proposed_abilities.name: 截步護區
proposed_abilities.trigger: 完整四件、存活且著地，主動指定身前3公尺內區域
proposed_abilities.effect: 2秒內抵擋一次來自區域內的可攔截近戰命中，對普通攻擊者施加0.5秒硬直；22秒冷卻
proposed_abilities.limits: 不擋子彈、範圍爆炸或持續傷害；頭目可免硬直；一次命中即耗盡；敵人攻擊類型需明確標示
proposed_abilities.stop: 死亡、卸下任何一件或離開關卡即停止；未結算承傷須按能力規格結清，不以卸裝取消代價。
proposed_abilities.integration_note: 新玩法，尚未接入runtime、多人同步或平衡；需先驗證觸發、取消、重複事件與邊界。
proposed_abilities.equipment_dependency: 完整C裝甲四件；B背包可獨立混搭，不繼承此能力。
proposed_abilities.visual: 技能顯示與收納裝置需後續另行設計，現有概念圖不代表機制已完成。

modeling_authority: 本輪概念圖及逐張目視紀錄定義採用外觀；三視與拆解為建模參考。少量透視、遮擋或跨視細節須在模型統一，不可當精確尺寸、UV或已完工資產。
